company.name: Reliable Nepal Life Insurance Company Limited
company.mergerHistory: Operates independently; separate from Reliance Life, which merged into Sanima Reliance Life.
company.about: Reliable Nepal Life Insurance is a Nepali life insurer that began operating on 31 August 2017 (Bhadra 15, 2074 BS) and has branches across the country. Plan details here are indicative because its website product pages could not be read.
highlights: Paid-up capital about Rs 4.64 arba (Q2 FY 2081/82)
Sells the Reliable Sulabh Jeevan Bima Yojana, a 20-year plan with disability rider
Paid a Rs 50 lakh permanent disability claim in 2026
company.claimSettlementNote: FY 2081/82, by amount: claims paid / (claims paid + claims outstanding), derived by Beema Portal from NIA Annual Report FY 2081/82 schedules 14-15 (NIA publishes no per-company ratio; year-end snapshot, excludes rejected claims). Third-party derived estimate.

policies.name: Reliable Sulabh Jeevan Bima Yojana
policies.summary: A 20-year life plan that pays a lump sum at maturity or to your family on death, with a disability rider available.
features: Fixed premium over the policy term
Life cover from day one (after underwriting)
Policy loan available after surrender value is acquired
benefits: Maturity benefit paid if you survive the term
exclusions: Suicide within the first policy year
Death due to concealed pre-existing conditions or false declaration
bestFor: Regular savers wanting a medium-term plan
